answer.original_source: NVIDIA Corporation, in its company blog post dated 2026-07-01.
answer.new_information: NVIDIA announced a model in which AI clouds procure NVIDIA infrastructure with revenue sharing and credit support. NVIDIA says it will earn standard product revenue plus a share of cloud revenue on supported capacity, creating a usage-linked earnings stream. The record gives no amount, timing, revenue-share rate, credit exposure, or realized results, so it does not establish materiality.
